Account summary
- Enterprise prospect (payments + retail banking). Evaluating Redwood Dedicated for latency-sensitive LLM workloads.

- Strong interest in how we detect/handle perf regressions during runtime releases (they’ve been burned by “silent” latency increases with another vendor).

Key contacts (per AE notes)
- Director of AI Platform (technical buyer)
- SRE Manager (influencer; cares about paging + incident hygiene)
- Procurement + Security (control gate)

Workloads / requirements
- Use cases:
  - Agent-assist summarization of support chats + internal tickets (streaming UI)
  - Doc-search/RAG over policy + KB (embeddings + reranking later; phase 2)
- Traffic shape (stated): weekday peaks; bursty after incident events.
- Latency targets:
  - Streaming chat: first token p95 <= 250ms (in-region), steady-state decode stable (no “sawtooth” during batching changes)
  - Non-streaming: end-to-end p95 <= 2.5s for typical prompts
  - Strong emphasis on p95/p99 consistency and change control
- Throughput targets:
  - Wants predictable tokens/sec under reserved capacity; cares about avoiding “capacity drift” after model/runtime updates
- Model preferences:
  - Open models preferred for cost + control; willing to evaluate curated catalog
  - Needs ability to pin model + runtime build during release windows

Dedicated / deployment constraints
- Dedicated capacity required (data isolation + predictable throughput). Prefer VPC deployment.
- Regions: initial ask us-east; follow-on eu-west (data residency requests from EU subsidiary).
- “No cross-region routing without explicit opt-in.” Wants a documented failover posture.

Security/compliance
- Must-have: SAML SSO, audit logging, KMS integration, retention controls.
- Asked about log contents: wants assurance that prompts used for any monitoring/canaries are synthetic and not customer data.
- Wants to understand our deploy/change management and rollback process.

Performance regression monitoring (notable)
